gaps: activeLayer (which layer the user navigates) and the navigation of a layer's own Viewpoint are held, not acted on: the user always navigates the world's camera

picking does not respect layers: a ray hits the meshes of every layer, and pickable / objectType / viewport are held
lights of the world light the meshes of every layer; a layer has no lights of its own
order without any visible layer draws the world (Babylon needs a camera)
